digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — Bedrock native support
propositions: Rebar has no native Bedrock provider; OpenAI-compatible gateway workaround loses prompt caching, native structured output, and requires operator-managed proxy infrastructure.

Bedrock prompt caching is model-dependent and fails silently (opus-4-5 reports zero cache_read/cache_write while billing full input), requiring a warning when caching was requested but both counters remain zero after a non-zero input.

Bedrock rejects temperature parameter on some models (opus-4-7: 400 ValidationException 'temperature is deprecated for this model') with no pydantic-ai fallback, blocking Pass-2 verify steps that deliberately send temperature=0; this requires a per-model capability override and error translation.

An exact-model-id override table must be added alongside f184's existing profile-shaped predicates, keyed on model_name to distinguish which Bedrock model ids support temperature, without widening f184's signed Callable[[ModelProfile], bool] contract.

The builder must construct BedrockConverseModel with exactly two cache keys (bedrock_cache_instructions, bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, and omit bedrock_cache_messages.
Bedrock integration ships as a [bedrock] optional extra so boto3 remains absent from the default [agents] install, with the extra added to dev so unit tests run in CI rather than skipping.
